Same exposed metadata/body across full/header/catalogue and reopen despite order and whitespace. Singleton ambiguity uses the documented deterministic policy.
Use the valid historical message date, even with a conflicting provider INTERNALDATE; no invented now().
Expose original sender and explicit Reply-To correctly. Sender/delegate must not replace From or silently retarget reply. Raw unknown fields remain retrievable.
Preserve both To and both Cc mailboxes in order for Reader/Reply All; empty Bcc members add nobody. If deviating from the concatenation recommendation, document and test the deviation explicitly.
Only the two real identifiers contribute to threading; words are ignored, with account isolation and no cycles.
Compare the semantic ID left.part@example.test without treating comments as identity bytes. Preserve original source, and never apply encoded-word decoding while normalizing CFWS.
Reader displays the correct Subject/body; optional informational headers neither override identity nor trigger actions. Original fields remain available via raw fetch.
A prepended resent block does not replace original From, Reply-To, Date or conversation identity; preserve original header source. No sending occurs merely because these fields exist.
Trace headers do not override Date/From or become reply destinations; body remains readable and raw trace bytes retrievable.
Unknown header does not reject the message, alter known identity or create a privileged action. Raw fetch/export retains the uninterpreted bytes.
Equivalent quoting or preserved CFWS must not decode or alter literal local-part bytes.

declarationIntegrityLimit: The standards matrix indexes direct assertion-bearing tests. The Rust declaration scanner does not follow the awaited corpus helpers; those wrappers are backed by the governed case index, actual 51-test execution and independent review, not falsely indexed helper assertions.
independentReview: Finite corpus/oracles, exact control policies, generator guard, SMTP action/positive control and final unchanged-source warm evidence approved. Product owners separately approved vendor grammar and final narrow core representation hunk.
limits: Not exhaustive RFC grammar, all grammar combinations or a standards certificate.
Core/cache projection is not frontend Reader or Tauri execution.
No WebKit/native glyph, escaping, layout, clipboard, search or provider acceptance.
One focused passing run is not the separate three-consecutive-full-source baseline.
Original programme and composite catalogue gaps remain separate from finite standards entries.
